hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if ! echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'git push'; then exit 0; fi; cd /home/user/jotty-android && output=$(./gradlew ktlintFormat -q 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then if echo "$output" | grep -q 'com.android.application\|Plugin.*not found\|could not resolve'; then exit 0; fi; printf '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "ktlintFormat a échoué. Corrige les erreurs avant de pusher."}'; exit 0; fi; if ! git diff --quiet; then printf '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "ktlint a corrigé des violations de style. Fais git add + commit des fichiers modifiés avant de pusher."}'; exit 0; fi
